en.title: Left-Wing Group Launches Campaign Against Elif Eralp
en.dek: Elif Eralp faces criticism from left-wing activists and a Jewish newspaper editor over her stance on Hamas supporters.
facts: Ines Schwerdtner says recent coverage attempts to discredit Eralp.
Schwerdtner notes fear of Hamas is deeply human.
Philipp Heymann-Engel criticizes Eralp's handling of Hamas supporters as capitulation.
Heymann-Engel calls it a "capitulation statement" and a "revelation oath".
Eralp is a left-wing candidate in Berlin.
body: On 31 October 2026, a left-wing group launched a campaign against Elif Eralp, a left-wing candidate. According to Die Zeit, Ines Schwerdtner sees the coverage as an attempt to discredit Eralp.
Schwerdtner also comments that fear of Hamas is deeply human.
Philipp Heymann-Engel, chief editor of the Jewish Allgemeine, criticized Eralp's handling of Hamas supporters. He called it a "capitulation statement" and a "revelation oath".
Eralp is a left-wing candidate in Berlin.
en.context: Elif Eralp is a left-wing candidate in Berlin. A left-wing group has begun a campaign against her, citing concerns about her stance on Hamas supporters. The campaign reflects tensions within left-wing politics regarding security and political alliances.

problemsFixed: Title references a left‑wing group launching a campaign, which is not supported by the sources.
Body contains an unsupported claim that a left‑wing group launched a campaign against Eralp.
Context includes an unsupported claim that a left‑wing group began a campaign and a speculative statement about tensions within left‑wing politics.
Several sentences lack proper attribution to the source.
The draft uses the phrase “campaign” which is not mentioned in the sources.
